title: NFTokenModify
key_points: The NFTokenModify transaction type allows the owner of an NFT to modify its properties.
It can change metadata, add or remove tags, and update the URL associated with the NFT.
The modified properties are committed to the XRP Ledger's immutable history upon successful validation.
No new tokens are created by this operation; only the existing token's properties are updated.
limitations: This documentation is provided 'as-is', without warranty of any kind, express or implied.
asserts: The NFTokenModify transaction enables owners to update various attributes of their non-fungible tokens in the XRP Ledger.
